Room Concept Renders

8m × 6m room · 4 projectors, one per wall · 2× Azure Kinect · PC search station · 500 research projects

Open the interactive 3D room →
Concept 01
Wide shot, empty room
No visitors. The particle sea drifts across all four walls, thrown by four projectors hanging from the centre of the ceiling. The PC sits under them in the middle of the room. A small SDG bar chart on the east wall shows how the 500 projects split across the goals.
Room size
8m × 6m, 3.6m ceiling
Projectors
4, in a central ceiling cluster, aimed N / E / S / W
Projection
All four walls, near full height. Needs wide-angle lenses
Tracking
2× Azure Kinect, NW and SE ceiling corners
Search
PC station in the middle of the room
SDG chart
Small panel on the east wall, about 1.9m wide
Concept 02
A visitor at the wall
A visitor stands in front of the north projector, so they cast a shadow on the wall. The Kinects track their body and the dots move out of the way of the silhouette. Their raised hand pulls a cluster in, and a project card appears next to it. SDG 12, Responsible Consumption and Production, makes up most of the sea in this shot.
Concept 03
Searching "textiles" at the PC
A visitor types "textiles" at the PC. Most of the sea fades out, and the matching projects (SDG 12, 8 and 9) light up across the walls with project cards. The bar chart on the east wall switches to show just the matches.
Concept 04
A group in the room
Three visitors at once. Two stand at different walls, each with their own shadow and their own cluster, while the third searches at the PC.
Concept 05
Equipment layout
Cutaway with the south and west walls removed. It shows the projector cluster and the beam from each projector to its wall, the floor area each Kinect covers, the PC station, the SDG chart and the entrance.
Concept 06
Plan with the walls unfolded
Top-down plan, with each wall laid flat on the side it belongs to, so all four projections can be read at once. The centre shows the projector cluster, the PC, the two Kinect coverage areas and the beam lines to each wall.
